title: Flat functors in the context of fibration categories
summary: We investigate the connection between left exact $\infty$-functors between finitely complete quasicategories and exact functors between fibration categories, describing a procedure to approximate flat $\infty$-functors of the former type by exact functors of the latter type. As an application, we recover a proof of the DK-equivalence between the relative category of fibration categories and that of finitely complete quasicategories.
